findings.title: Incorrect type guard in ObjectIsArrayBufferView uses OtherObject instead of TypedArray
findings.message: In `Typer::Visitor::ObjectIsArrayBufferView`, after a parent commit changed `TypeJSCreateTypedArray` to return `Type::TypedArray()` instead of `Type::OtherObject()`, commit 65beb80d9cd added an early true-return for pure TypedArray inputs but failed to update the false-return guard on the next line. The condition `!type.Maybe(Type::OtherObject())` is still checked to decide whether to return `singleton_false_`. Because typed arrays are now typed as `TypedArray` (not `OtherObject`) in the type lattice, a union type like `TypedArray | Boolean` satisfies `!type.Maybe(Type::OtherObject())` (neither TypedArray nor Boolean overlaps OtherObject), so the function incorrectly returns `singleton_false_` — asserting that the value *cannot* be an ArrayBufferView even when it is a typed array. This incorrect type annotation creates a type contradiction in Turbofan's incremental type-propagation loop, triggering a FATAL assertion at line 451 (`UpdateType error`) when the propagated type widens unexpectedly.
findings.suggestion: Change the false-return guard from `Type::OtherObject()` to `Type::TypedArray()` so that any type that could possibly be a TypedArray is not prematurely ruled out as a non-ArrayBufferView.

ground_truth.root_cause: A preceding commit (c95eccc3885) changed `TypeJSCreateTypedArray` to return `Type::TypedArray()` rather than `Type::OtherObject()`, making TypedArrays a distinct type in the Turbofan type lattice. Commit 65beb80d9cd partially adapted `ObjectIsArrayBufferView` by adding a true-return for pure TypedArray types, but left the false-return guard checking `Type::OtherObject()`. Since `TypedArray` is disjoint from `OtherObject`, any union type containing `TypedArray` (e.g., `TypedArray | Boolean`, which arises in `reduceRight` where the accumulator starts as a TypedArray and subsequent iterations pass in a boolean) satisfies `!type.Maybe(Type::OtherObject())`, incorrectly causing the function to return `singleton_false_` and assert that the value can never be an ArrayBufferView.
